Contingency planning. 
- The facility contingency plan does not address vehicle breakdowns or vehicle accidents. As a traveling exhibitor, 
problems such as breakdowns or accidents should reasonably have been anticipated and addressed in the contingency 
plan. Failure to consider appropriate responses to these problems could result in inappropriate actions taken during an 
actual emergency. The facility should modify their contingency plan to include appropriate responses to the potential 
occurrence of mechanical breakdowns and/or vehicle accidents. 
Corrected at the time of inspection. 
 
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with licensee. 
 
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with 
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must 
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
